evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's official OS OpenMap - Local product documentation states that the open product is available as vector data, including GeoPackage, contains important buildings, and uses generalised building geometries derived from OS MasterMap. The selected source window is the distinct OS Downloads API request for product OpenMapLocal, area SX, format GeoPackage, redirect=true. The request did not yield a retrievable payload in the available web channel; a direct network attempt also failed at DNS resolution before any GeoPackage bytes or ImportantBuilding feature could be read. No record geometry, classification, theme or name was inferred or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: The official OS OpenMap - Local documentation states that the product contains generalised building geometries; the selected SX GeoPackage payload itself could not be read.
field_evidence.type_use: The immediately prior verified OS ImportantBuilding schema establishes record-bound buildingTheme/classification/distinctiveName semantics, but this new SX download payload was not readable and no individual values were observed.
